svg.title: LeilMat
svg.desc: Sibling to leil.xyz/favicon.svg. Same 554x462 viewBox and dot positions/radii so the LeilMat icon reads as part of the Leil family at 16x16 in a browser tab. The five internal dots keep the master mark's three-gray palette (#9ca3af, #d1d5db, #6b7280); only the moon shape is recoloured to LeilMat's warm gold (#f7af41, matching the accent variable hsl(38 96% 60%)) so the icon reads as LeilMat-branded but still in the family.
